name: core
description: v2.39.19 (2026-07-06) - #63 fix: /core:start now DOCUMENTS the H-Sutra header contract it enforces — the header format (DIRECTION/VERB/TIMING/CHANNEL/REV/RISK) is written into CLAUDE.md as its own section, closing the invisible-rule gap that caused repeated 'redo with the header' blocks. After update, re-run /core:start to regenerate the block. (A4 block-text validation ships separately via #73.) + v2.39.18 (2026-06-30) - loop-budget-guard per-turn reset + agent-orchestration exemption: fixes the session-wide 'tool-budget guard hard-stopped further file reads' deadlock. The guard's call counter was cumulative-per-session and never reset, so a long working session crossed the 250 ceiling on ordinary Bash/Read/Write calls and hard-stopped itself. New loopguard-turn-reset.sh (UserPromptSubmit) truncates the counter at the start of each real user turn (budget is now per-turn; a 250-call runaway in one turn still blocks; synthetic turns skipped). Agent/Task/Workflow dispatches are exempt (a fan-out is not a loop). (A4 block-text validation lands separately via PR #73.) + v2.39.16 (2026-06-15) - D61 amendment: Flow fires via an INLINE block (literal text, like Input Routing), not a Skill invocation — a hook cannot force a Skill, so skill-every-turn was skipped on no-tool turns; the full core:flow Skill is the deep mode for substantive work. Marker-persistence fix: marker writes use the Write tool (Claude Code rolls back sandboxed Bash writes to .claude/). Operating system for building with AI. See CHANGELOG.md.
